tasks.label: Android: Build & Run App (Active Device / Emulator)
Android: Run on Phone (ADB)
tasks.command: serial=$(adb devices | awk '$2=="device" && $1 !~ /^emulator-/ {print $1; exit}'); [ -n "$serial" ] || { echo 'No physical device connected via ADB.' >&2; exit 1; }; android run --device="$serial" "app?"

windows.command: $serial = (adb devices | Select-String '^\S+\s+device$' | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch '^emulator-' } | Select-Object -First 1) -replace '\s+device$',''; if (-not $serial) { Write-Error 'No physical device connected via ADB.'; exit 1 }; android run --device=$serial "app?"

tasks.label: Android: Build & Run App on Emulator
tasks.command: serial=$(adb devices | awk '$2=="device" && $1 ~ /^emulator-/ {print $1; exit}'); if [ -n "$serial" ]; then android run --device="$serial" "app?"; else android run "app?"; fi

windows.command: $serial = (adb devices | Select-String '^emulator-\S+\s+device$' | Select-Object -First 1) -replace '\s+device$',''; if ($serial) { android run --device=$serial "app?" } else { android run "app?" }

tasks.label: Android: Launch Emulator + Run App
dependsOn: Android: Build & Run App on Emulator

tasks.label: Gradle: Install & Launch Debug APK
tasks.command: ./gradlew installDebug && adb shell am start -n dev.shiqan.materialwidgets/.MainActivity

windows.command: .\gradlew.bat installDebug; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { adb shell am start -n dev.shiqan.materialwidgets/.MainActivity }
